reviews.reviewbody: In this collection (these are great) we find that the office secretaries still don't know how to operate the phone systems, that LBJ was at one time, considering Richard Nixon or Robert Kennedy to lead the investigation into JFK's assasination, talks to Martin Luther King for guidance, still isn't crazy about becoming president, has a lot of reading to do, is unaware of important bills, and prepares for JFK's funeral! Ya! GREAT stuff! Lots lots more to come!
